_meta.verses: 20:24, 20:29–32, 28:34, 20:43–44, 20:46, 20:90, 20:91, 7:151, 37:120, 37:122 complete, edition eng-ummmuhammad (Saheeh) (fawazahmed0 quran-api); brackets removed, names per names/names.json (Moses→Musa, Aaron→Harun)

s1a: Noah… Ilyas… you two are brothers. Tell me: if one of you has to do something difficult, does the other one help?
s1b: Of course! Ilyas always helps me with my homework!
s1c: That’s lovely, my dear. Get warm and cosy… Today I’ll tell you about two brothers who were both prophets: Musa and his brother Harun, peace be upon them. And today our story is about Harun.
s2a: Do you remember? At the fire on the mountain, Allah said to Musa: “Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.” And Musa prayed to his Lord: “And appoint for me a minister from my family, Harun, my brother. Increase through him my strength, and let him share my task.”
s2b: And why did Musa want Harun, of all people?
s2c: Musa said: “And my brother Harun is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me.” And Allah told him that He would make him strong through his brother. And Allah made Harun a prophet too, a gift from His mercy.
s3a: Then Allah said to the two brothers: “Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed. And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear Allah.” Musa and Harun said: Our Lord, we are afraid. “Allah said, Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.”
s3b: So they went together? Like a team!
s3c: Exactly, like a team. They went together to Pharaoh and told him what Allah had commanded them. And Allah saved them, together with the Children of Israel, at the sea. I told you about that last time.
s4a: After they were saved, Allah called Musa to the mountain for forty nights. Before he left, he said to his brother Harun: Take my place among my people, do what is right, and do not follow the way of those who spread corruption.
s4b: But while Musa was away, a man called Samiri made a calf that made a sound, from the people’s golden jewellery. And they said: This is your god! And many people followed him.
s4c: A calf made of gold? That can’t be a god!
s4d: You’re right, my dear. And that is what Harun said: “And Harun had already told them before, O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order.” But “they said, We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Musa returns to us.”
s5a: When Musa came back and saw what had happened, he became very angry and sad. He took hold of his brother’s head and asked him: Why didn’t you follow me when you saw them going astray?
s5b: Oh no! Was Harun angry with him then?
s5c: The Quran doesn’t tell us that, my dear. But it tells us what Harun said: Son of my mother, let me go. I was afraid you would say: You have divided the Children of Israel. The people thought I was weak, and they nearly killed me.
s5d: Then Musa prayed to his Lord: “Musa said, My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.”
s6a: Allah praises the two brothers in the Quran. He says: “Peace upon Musa and Harun.” “Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.”
s6b: Did our Prophet Muhammad also talk about Harun?
s6c: Yes! When our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, went on a long journey to Tabuk, he left his cousin Ali in Madinah with the women and children. And he said to him: “Are you not pleased to be to me like Harun was to Musa, except that there is no prophet after me?”
s7a: Oh… they’re asleep already. My dears… stay together like Musa and Harun. Help each other when something is hard. Tell the truth, even if many people do wrong. And if someone misunderstands you, stay kind and explain it calmly.
s7b: And next time, I’ll tell you about Dhul-Kifl… a prophet the Quran mentions in only a few words, but very special ones. And you, watching us right now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don’t miss the next story. Good night, my dears. May Allah protect you.
